risks.quote: results and outputs produced by generative AI tools may be inaccurate, irrelevant is misleading
Users should have a clear understanding of how AI systems make decisions and the underlying algorithms used, including the risks, limitations and biases within said algorithms.

responsibilities.quote: All users of AI applications within the University and its programmes must adhere to ethical principles, respecting human rights, privacy, and data protection.
Users must always ensure the accuracy of results produced by generative AI tools.
Use of any AI applications must comply with relevant General Data Protection Regulations (GDPR).
The University will provide necessary accommodations and support to ensure equitable access to AI-based resources and services.
Formally, this policy will be reviewed at least annually.
